title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "Zheyre Tolliver"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE,
  progress_bar = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE,
  progress_bar = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
income_tx |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    labels = scales::label_dollar(),
    na.value = "gray80"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County, 2020",
    subtitle = "American Community Survey 5-year estimates (2016 to 2020)",
    fill = "Median income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
